Priya / Neha —

Initial findings:
- Catalog promotion log: promotion job #PR-8724 completed at 08:22:17 PT; default routing started at 08:25:04 PT.
- The promoted variant uses the new fp8 quantization + optimized attention kernel. We saw an uptick in CPU time on the control plane threads responsible for prefix/KV cache invalidation during the first 10m after flip.
- Trace dump (attached as trace-logs.zip) shows a subset of requests hitting a code path that falls back to a slow softmax implementation for sequence lengths > 1024; we hadn’t exercised that path in perf tests.

Immediate mitigations I can perform:
1) Rollback promotion to previous 8-bit symmetric variant (takes ~4–6 minutes to ramp). This will restore known perf profile.
2) Temporarily pin Acme’s routing policy to the previous model variant (no global rollback) — low blast radius and quick.

I recommend option 2 as a first step while we keep the promotion for others. Harper — can you confirm whether you can accept a per-tenant pin? If yes, we’ll do it now and monitor.

Attachments: trace-logs.zip

-Dev
